predictions.title: LLM-tooling + Linux-kernel CVE chain becomes dominant attack pattern by H2 2026
predictions.body: The two legs of this prediction have separated. The LLM-tooling leg is well-evidenced: the May 1 Copy Fail LPE, the Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi key-leak, and the unpatched SGLang RCE all landed, and the n8n CVE is now in a remediation taper toward the May 21 deadline. The distinguishing claim -- an LLM-tooling CVE chained with a Linux-kernel LPE for full-chain root on multi-tenant inference -- has not. The May 17 bridge (validation.694de9c1ba92152f, support 'given', weakly supported) records that the weekend surfaces no IR-firm post-mortem chaining an LLM-tooling CVE with a kernel privilege escalation, and the May 6 bridge (validation.2acf81f29d46b4e6) states the kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated. The LLM-tooling leg landing alone does not realize the chained thesis; the kernel-chaining leg remains the open gap into H2 2026.

reasoning.because: LLM-tooling leg landed (Copy Fail, LiteLLM, SGLang); the kernel-chaining leg has no evidence
reasoning.given: Bridges May 6 + May 17 record no IR post-mortem, no demonstrated kernel-CVE half of the chain
reasoning.so_that: the distinguishing LLM-tooling-plus-kernel-LPE chain stays unrealized even as the LLM-tooling leg is well-evidenced
reasoning.landing: LLM-tooling leg evidenced; kernel-chaining leg open into H2 2026
reasoning.plain_language: AI-tooling bugs are real and proven. Joining one to a Linux bug to seize a shared server has not been shown. That part stays open.

predictions.summary: May 1 Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with cloud-provider in-the-wild use, layered onto the Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak and unpatched SGLang RCE, plus ATT&CK v19's agentic technique names and CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization, set up at least one IR-firm public post-mortem and one CSAI CNA advisory naming the LLM-tooling + kernel chain by H2 2026.

reasoning_ja.because: LLMツーリングのレッグは成立した(Copy Fail、LiteLLM、SGLang)が、カーネル連鎖のレッグは証拠を生んでいない
reasoning_ja.given: 5月6日と5月17日のブリッジは、IRポストモーテムの不在と、フルチェーンのカーネルCVE側が未実証であることを記録している
reasoning_ja.so_that: LLMツーリングのレッグが十分に立証されていても、特徴的なLLMツーリング+カーネルLPE連鎖は未実現のままとなる
reasoning_ja.landing: LLMツーリングのレッグは立証済み;カーネル連鎖のレッグは2026年下半期まで未解決
reasoning_ja.plain_language: AIツーリングのバグは実在し実証済みだ。それをLinuxのバグと結んで共有サーバーを奪う部分はまだ示されていない。そこは未解決だ。

reasoning_es.because: La leg de tooling-LLM aterrizo (Copy Fail, LiteLLM, SGLang) pero la leg de encadenamiento con kernel no ha producido evidencia
reasoning_es.given: Los bridges del 6 may y 17 may registran que no hay post-mortem de firma IR ni mitad de CVE de kernel demostrada de la cadena completa
reasoning_es.so_that: la cadena distintiva tooling-LLM mas LPE de kernel sigue sin realizarse aunque la leg de tooling-LLM este bien evidenciada
reasoning_es.landing: leg de tooling-LLM evidenciada; leg de encadenamiento con kernel abierta hacia el H2 2026
reasoning_es.plain_language: Los bugs de tooling de IA son reales y probados. Unir uno a un bug de Linux para tomar un servidor compartido aun no se ha mostrado. Esa parte sigue abierta.

reasoning_fil.because: Nag-land ang LLM-tooling leg (Copy Fail, LiteLLM, SGLang) ngunit walang naibigay na ebidensya ang kernel-chaining leg
reasoning_fil.given: Itinatala ng May 6 + May 17 bridges na walang IR post-mortem at walang naipakitang kernel-CVE half ng buong chain
reasoning_fil.so_that: ang natatanging LLM-tooling-plus-kernel-LPE chain ay nananatiling hindi natutupad kahit na well-evidenced ang LLM-tooling leg
reasoning_fil.landing: may ebidensya ang LLM-tooling leg; bukas ang kernel-chaining leg hanggang H2 2026
reasoning_fil.plain_language: Totoo at napatunayan na ang AI-tooling bugs. Ang pagsama ng isa sa Linux bug para agawin ang shared server ay hindi pa naipapakita. Bukas pa ang bahaging iyon.
